segments.sn27.5:1.2: “Yo, bhikkhave, cakkhusamphassajāya vedanāya chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso.
segments.sn27.5:1.3: Yo sotasamphassajāya vedanāya … yo ghānasamphassajāya vedanāya … yo jivhāsamphassajāya vedanāya … yo kāyasamphassajāya vedanāya … yo manosamphassajāya vedanāya chandarāgo, cittasseso upakkileso.
segments.sn27.5:1.8: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno … pe … abhiññā sacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesū”ti.
